source_partition.T: all token positions whose token IDs differ between the paired narrative recipient and donor: A1 positions 0 and 4; A2 positions 3, 5, and 7
source_partition.R: all remaining causally available source positions
source_partition.control_meaning: on P and C, the changed-token positions are irrelevant subject rewrites; they test whether a T-labelled intervention merely reacts to any lexical difference

fixed_arms: S-score: donor p_S times recipient u_S
S-value: recipient p_S times donor u_S
S-joint: donor p_S times donor u_S
T-score: donor p_T times recipient u_T for all T positions
T-value: recipient p_T times donor u_T for all T positions
T-joint: donor p_T times donor u_T for all T positions
R-joint: donor p_R times donor u_R for all R positions
Task14-singular self value: narrative recipient p_S times the frozen Task14 singular u_8
Task14-plural self value: narrative recipient p_S times the frozen Task14 plural u_8

cross_task_pairing.algorithm: Sort the 32 fronted Task14 rows by group_id. Pair narrative group_number g with sorted Task14 row g; A1 and A2 reuse the same pair. From each row take exactly one singular/is endpoint and one plural/are endpoint. Persist all 64 target-row pair records and their canonical digest.
cross_task_pairing.state_alignment: For a narrative donor answer is, singular/is is matched and plural/are is unmatched. For a narrative donor answer was, plural/are is matched and singular/is is unmatched.
cross_task_pairing.interpretation: Both directions are required. In particular, a Task14 plural/are value must improve full-vocabulary CE for narrative was; suppressing is while boosting are is not semantic transfer.

fixed_bars.P_C_absolute_normalized_movement: no tested within-narrative route arm may exceed complete-H3 movement in the same control family

registered_predictions.self_route: S-joint clears all route bars and exceeds T-joint by at least 0.15 in every target cell.
registered_predictions.tense_cue_route: T-joint clears all route bars and exceeds S-joint by at least 0.15 in every target cell.
registered_predictions.mixed_or_remaining_route: Neither exclusive route prediction passes; report R and downstream interactions without forcing a label.
registered_predictions.factor_readout: Within a winning route, score-only or value-only clears 0.70 of its joint effect. Both passing means redundant/interactive support; neither means score-value composition is required.
registered_predictions.cross_task_semantic_reuse: Matched Task14 singular and plural values both move their registered narrative state donorward, improve the correct narrative token's full-vocabulary CE, and clear the recovery bar; unmatched states move recipientward.
registered_predictions.generic_output_token_confound: Only the singular/is transfer works, or the plural/are vector suppresses is without improving full-vocabulary CE for was. This is not shared semantic-state evidence.

novelty_delta: First exact below-head source-route decomposition for narrative tense and first registered cross-task payload test designed to separate shared operational state from a common copula token. It uses no fitted subspace, rank reduction, activation reconstruction, or post-outcome donor choice.
decision_changed: The source route determines which exact H3 factors merit QK decomposition. Bidirectional cross-task success licenses grouping agreement and tense by downstream causal response; same-is-only success preserves a generic output-token explanation; failure blocks this registered mapping without claiming that no alternative mapping exists.
